name: Star Wars Yoda
look: Yoda, the small green Jedi Master with long pointed ears and wispy white hair, stands in a dim green forest wearing a rough cream robe over brown clothes. He holds a short wooden walking stick with both hands and gives a faint, knowing smile.
use: Wise advice or silly observations written in Yoda's backwards speech. The top and bottom captions flip normal word order, such as "Clean my room, I will not," so the line sounds like the Jedi Master.
slots: top caption: first half of the backwards sentence
bottom caption: second half, usually ending with the verb
examples: Finished my homework, I have not
Watched three seasons instead, I did
Reply all to the company email, you must not
describe: little green jedi master with big ears smiling
small green alien with pointy ears holding a cane
old wise green creature in a robe in a swamp
green puppet master in a brown robe looking amused
wise green guy from the space movie who talks backwards
origin: Yoda on the swamp planet Dagobah in the 1980 film Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back.
